name: E. Jay Abt
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
about: E. Jay Abt operates The Abt Law Firm, LLC, providing criminal defense representation throughout Atlanta, Georgia, with a focus on serious criminal matters. With three decades of legal experience, this trial-oriented attorney handles complex criminal cases across federal, state and juvenile jurisdictions. He established his Atlanta-based practice in 2000, founding the firm on the principle that individuals facing criminal charges deserve vigorous legal advocacy.

Mr. Abt's approach to criminal defense differs significantly from conventional legal representation. Rather than following standard procedures, he develops aggressive and resourceful strategies tailored to each client's unique circumstances. His commitment extends beyond typical attorney-client relationships, as he invests considerable time understanding individual needs and applying comprehensive legal knowledge to achieve favorable outcomes.

With a Bachelor of Arts degree in Japanese history from Emory University, where Mr. Abt graduated summa cum laude in 1992, he subsequently earned his law degree from Emory University School of Law in 1995. He was then considered for law review at American University Washington College of Law. His legal credentials span multiple jurisdictions, including membership in both the State Bar of Georgia and the Illinois State Bar Association.

Over the past 25 years, Mr. Abt has built a reputation for delivering results through dedicated client service and thorough case preparation. He maintains active membership in several professional organizations, including the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. He holds admission privileges in numerous courts, including the Supreme Court of Georgia, all three federal districts within Georgia, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit and the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois.

Recognition for Mr. Abt's legal work includes coverage by major news networks such as FOX News Network, Cable News Network (CNN), NBC Universal Media (NBC) and local Atlanta media outlets. His professional achievements have earned him inclusion in America's Top 100 Criminal Defense Attorneys and an AV Preeminent peer-review rating* through Martindale-Hubbell. He is also recognized among Georgia Trend Magazine’s Best Lawyers list, reflecting his standing within the legal community.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
